environment: Production static export, Codex in-app browser, localhost:3002/performance-check.html, 100 percent zoom
runtimeChanges: The main Battlefield group handler executes formation orders through the shared battle worker.
Animation routes are reconstructed only for currently visible actors that were also visible before the update.
Group controls and reports no longer change map height. Route detail is collapsed by default.

patrolBeforeVisibleMotionFix.note: The UI rebuilt motion routes for hidden patrol units.

sixSoldiersDuringSceneryPreparation.note: This sample overlaps conversion of the new scenery and does not meet the target.

normalControls.selection: Shift-clicked squad portraits 2 through 6 with soldier 1 already selected.
normalControls.order: Activated the accessible R24 ground cell through the shared Battlefield handler.
normalControls.result: Six soldiers reached R24, S24, T24, U24, V24 and W24. The report recorded 54 seconds.
normalControls.compactPanel: The report and return-to-individual-orders button were visibly present. Clearing the group removed its panel.

limits: The patrol sample has 30 simulated enemies but only one becomes visible. It is not a 30-visible-enemy group benchmark. Route preview preparation remains synchronous and measured about 19 to 21 ms in these samples. Initial scenery conversion and full enemy-turn acceptance remain open.
